name: ripperclipper
description: Non-destructive VOD range editor and downloader for Twitch, Kick and YouTube
author: Ripper Clipper

scripts.build:experimental: npm run typecheck && cross-env RIPPER_CHANNEL=experimental electron-vite build
scripts.build:dev: npm run typecheck && cross-env RIPPER_CHANNEL=dev electron-vite build
scripts.package:win: npm run tools:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.js
scripts.package:win:experimental: npm run tools:win && npm run build:experimental && cross-env RIPPER_CHANNEL=experimental electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.js
scripts.package:win:dev: npm run tools:win && npm run build:dev && cross-env RIPPER_CHANNEL=dev electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.js
scripts.package:dir: npm run tools && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.js
